messages.text: help me plan the Tern 2.0 launch, three weeks from today
Three dates. Oct 12: the beta goes to the 40 teams on the waitlist. Oct 19: launch notes final, with Anna’s screens. Oct 21: launch, the changelog at noon.
The invite flow. It blocks the beta, and Jonas has it next to the billing work. If it slips past Oct 9, move the beta, not the launch.
a quiet café near mariatorget with a big table, open before 8
Kaffe Söder on Hornsgatan opens at 7:30 and has one long table by the window. Bönor & Bröd opens at 8, quieter, with small tables only.

messages.text: Two people edit the same list offline. Each change carries enough to be merged in any order, so when the copies meet they agree without asking who was first.
how do I export ledger to csv for the accountant?
Settings › Data › Export. Pick a range, CSV, and One file per account. Your accountant asked for September, so Sep 1 to 30.
ideas for a stockholm weekend with friends visiting
Friday: a late evening at Fotografiska. Saturday: the ferry to Vaxholm, lunch by the fortress. Sunday: a slow walk around Djurgården.
Nordkök is the cheapest by €1,900 but leaves out the worktop. With it, Hemma is cheaper and starts two weeks sooner.
a weekend in berlin in march with good museums
Friday: the Neue Nationalgalerie until 20:00. Saturday: Museum Island, the Pergamon panorama first.
